def transform(grid):
    # The separator divides two masks. Output their cellwise overlap.
    divider = next(i for i in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[i] != 0 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(grid))]
